correctness.rationale: Exact averaging of Rayleigh quotients on the even and odd (n−1)-dimensional paired subspaces bounds λ2 for arbitrary W; maximizing the resulting two affine functions proves the optimal value. Symmetric Laplacian eigenactions attain this bound; equality forces the entire odd subspace into the Fiedler eigenspace, and row-column constraints force every offmatching and matching weight to be constant for n≥3. Rational checker replay gives 498 exact supplementary checks.
